user.title: FlinQ Orion
user.description: Add the lamp without resetting it. Configure existing mesh keys and an experimental protocol in Options. Without keys the integration remains in observation mode.

init.title: Existing mesh network
init.description: Choose observe for passive diagnostics, query_only for reads, vendor_dp for experimental Tuya DP control or sig for SIG light models. Use existing keys and a dedicated unused unicast controller address (decimal input). Confirm this address has never been used by Smart Life or another controller. Keys are stored locally in HA config entry storage, without additional encryption; protect backups.

data.new_source_confirmed: I confirm the controller address is unique and has never previously been used

profile.title: Confirmed light metadata
profile.description: Leave unknown settings disabled. CT requires proven endpoints AND a linear Kelvin mapping. HSV must use the 12-hex-character format. Scene replay sends only previously received DP6 values. Mode codes must have been observed in reports and their meaning confirmed; -1 disables automatic mode selection. Countdown requires confirmed seconds and maximum.

data.ct_range_confirmed: Linear Kelvin mapping and CT endpoints are confirmed
data.white_mode_value: Confirmed white mode code (-1 if unknown)
data.color_mode_value: Confirmed color mode code (-1 if unknown)
data.scene_mode_value: Confirmed scene mode code (-1 if unknown)
data.countdown_seconds_confirmed: DP7 is confirmed as countdown in seconds
